title: Hilbert-Schmidt splitting along an orthogonal projection and the two-projection identity |P - Q|^2 = |(P - Q)P|^2 + |(P - Q)Q|^2
statement: For all natural numbers m, k, write R^m = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m). For a continuous linear X : R^m -> R^k let hsNormSq X = sum_{i<m} |X e_i|^2, where e_i is the standard basis. For a linear subspace K of R^m, P_K = K.starProjection is the orthogonal projection onto K and K^perp is its orthogonal complement. Then: (S1) for every continuous linear X : R^m -> R^k and every subspace K of R^m, hsNormSq X = hsNormSq (X o P_K) + hsNormSq (X o P_{K^perp}); (S2) for all subspaces K, L of R^m, writing P := P_K and Q := P_L, hsNormSq (P - Q) = hsNormSq ((P - Q) o P) + hsNormSq ((P - Q) o Q).
lean_statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (X : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k) (K : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)), hsNormSq X = hsNormSq (X ∘L K.starProjection) + hsNormSq (X ∘L Kᗮ.starProjection)) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (K L : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)), hsNormSq (K.starProjection - L.starProjection) = hsNormSq ((K.starProjection - L.starProjection) ∘L K.starProjection) + hsNormSq ((K.starProjection - L.starProjection) ∘L L.starProjection)
